responsibility: Provides the baked ICU locale-fallback likely-subtags payload for this data set, exposing a locale lookup that returns the single root (`und`) `LocaleFallbackLikelySubtagsV1` record used by the generated provider implementations.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files here that either just re-export child modules or cover different ICU keys, this one is a leaf data module for the `LocaleFallbackLikelySubtagsV1Marker`: it defines the concrete `lookup` function and root-only `UND` payload for likely-subtags fallback data.
